means: After every Perfect Clear in the corpus, the first T-spin within the window, and which of harddrop's DPC setups (dpc-setups.json) the board before it was, by occupancy, drawn or mirrored. Simulator output, one engine.
caveat: Boards are the vendored engine's. Most post-PC boards are past the verified prefix (each case carries `verified`); which setup a T went into has no second implementation. No claim id, no badge.

rules.pc_point: board empty after the lock, through the verified row map
rules.match: occupancy of the board before the T (garbage rows stripped from the bottom) equals a setup base, and the T cells and lines equal the setup's, drawn or mirrored, bottom-aligned
